nodes.meaning: A documented mismatch between an employer promise and reported work experience.
Brand messaging diverges from observed employee experience.
A dated recruiting claim and a specific contrary practice are verified for the same cohort.
Comparable hires report that specific recruiting promises are being met.
Employees report insufficient coaching, support or authority.
Interviews or records verify a management practice such as restricted decision rights or missing coaching.
Employees report unclear growth or advancement expectations.
A review verifies inconsistent onboarding responsibilities, role expectations or progression criteria.
Early exits rise for a defined entry cohort and follow-up window.
Matched role and location records show a meaningful internal or external pay discrepancy.
A cohort reports sustained work-related exhaustion or strain.
Overtime, staffing or workload records show sustained excess demand in the same cohort.
Comparable workload records show adequate capacity over the disputed window.
Roster records show short-notice changes or inconsistent hours in a shift-based cohort.
The cohort works shifts that can vary within and across weeks.
The target candidates predominantly encounter the mobile experience.
Intake reports a hard-to-use form, account wall or upload difficulty.
A candidate walkthrough or step events reproduce a blocking form obstacle.
Candidates who start the application abandon it before submission.
Eligible target candidates complete the instrumented form without unusual loss.
Fewer portal visits convert to submitted applications for the target role.
nodes.intake_pattern: applications are down|low qualified applicant conversion|weak applicant conversion

nodes.meaning: The intake identifies slow recruiter response after application or interview.
nodes.intake_pattern: slow candidate response|slow local[^.;]{0,50}interview handoffs|handoff delays|recruiter response delays

nodes.meaning: Application system timestamps locate the delay between distinct post-submission events.
The target cohort has protracted time from requisition to accepted offer.
The target role relies heavily on external staffing or agencies.
Invoices or placement records document agency reliance for the affected roles.
Job information omits relevant role details.
An ad audit verifies that requirements or valued job conditions are missing.
The channel has poor reach or discoverability for the target audience.
nodes.intake_pattern: near.zero reach|low organic reach|low passive candidate awareness

nodes.meaning: Corporate posts receive comparatively weak engagement.
Ratings vary across comparable sites, or site-level evidence is uneven.
Review volume, site counts and coverage affect the reliability of the reputation signal.
Site records or scoped listening verify a local employment or candidate experience issue.
Public reviews show weak perception of the employer.
Review monitoring or responses are handled manually or inconsistently.
Candidate feedback is collected in disconnected formats or systems.
A workflow audit verifies inconsistent invitations, capture, or ownership.
A small share of eligible candidates complete the feedback survey.
nodes.intake_pattern: low (?:survey )?response rate|low survey completion|poor feedback response

nodes.meaning: HR reports manual recording of employee posts or campaign results.
A workflow audit identifies manual steps, duplicates or missing attribution.
HR spends time on manual review or post tracking.
Employees already post voluntarily, regardless of formal program status.
Opt-in and relevant participation are verified for the target cohort.
Scoped evidence supports credible internal experience and willingness to participate.
Peer benchmark for employee-post engagement. It is not observed client engagement.
Finance requires an attributable and auditable measure of the employer-brand program.
Estimated cost of attrition. Expected exposure and realized savings are separate.
A reported healthy retention baseline for a specific cohort.
A role and location audit finds too few eligible applicants despite comparable distribution and a working apply flow.
Intake reports too few suitably qualified applicants.
nodes.intake_pattern: (?:too few|scarce|shortage of|few) (?:suitably )?qualified (?:applicants|candidates)|qualified applicant supply is limited

nodes.meaning: The relevant requisitions have a sufficient number of applicants meeting validated essential criteria.
Workflow timestamps show elapsed time between a documented hiring request and approval or release.
Intake reports vacancies waiting for budget or requisition sign-off.
Comparable hiring requests are approved or deliberately closed within the agreed local interval.
A workforce need remains open longer than expected from request through hire.
Scheduling records verify that eligible screened candidates wait for interview slots or panel capacity.
Intake reports difficulty booking an interview or assembling a panel after screening.
Comparable eligible candidates receive feasible interview slots without a material queue.
A high share of extended offers are declined for the target cohort.
Exit or decline records identify specific offer conditions that diverge from candidate requirements.
Candidates reportedly cite terms, working conditions or timing when declining offers.
Comparable candidates report that the offer terms meet their needs.
Qualified applicants are lost between application and screening progression.
An audit identifies screen criteria or questions that do not reflect validated essential role requirements.
Intake reports a mismatch between screening and actual role requirements.
Independent review confirms the criteria reflect essential job requirements.
Attribution and audience data show that the channel reaches a different population from the intended job cohort.
The intake distinguishes a channel's current audience from the target candidates.
The current channel gives the intended cohort sufficient opportunity to see the posting.
A material share of accepted offers fail to become starts.
nodes.intake_pattern: accepted offers? (?:do|did) not (?:turn into|become) starts|(?:pre.start|first.day) no.shows

nodes.meaning: Accepted offers and pre-start contact records identify missed or conflicting steps preceding scheduled starts.
Intake reports broken follow-up between offer acceptance and start.
Accepted candidates received and confirmed their required pre-start information.
A review finds qualified staff unable to discover or pursue available internal roles.
Employees report limited access to internal openings or transfers.
nodes.intake_pattern: (?:internal vacancies|internal jobs) (?:are )?(?:not posted|hidden)|(?:blocked|prevented) from applying internally

nodes.meaning: Eligible employees can discover and apply for the relevant internal roles.
Voluntary exits increased in a defined workforce and observation period.
Employees in the cohort identify a specific commuting or work-location constraint and the timing is verified.
Employees cite commuting or location requirements when considering leaving.
Work design, customer coverage and access requirements permit a local hybrid-work trial.
The role's essential work or access requirements prevent the proposed hybrid arrangement.
Independent confidential channels corroborate fear of speaking up or retaliation for raising concerns.
Employees report fear of speaking up about problems.
nodes.intake_pattern: (?:fear of|afraid to) speak(?:ing)? up|fear of retaliation

nodes.meaning: Two-way reporting shows low issue-raising or follow-up coverage despite a defined opportunity to report.
Multiple confidential sources corroborate practical access to a safe channel for raising concerns.
Review composition, platform mix or collection coverage changed in the relevant comparison period.
Intake reports a change in the mix of reviewers or review platforms.
Platform and cohort breakdowns show stable coverage over comparable periods.
A reconciliation finds duplicate, unmatched or missing source IDs in campaign-to-outcome records.
The intake reports missing attribution or duplicate tracking records.
Eligible reach or downstream hiring outcomes are unavailable or cannot be reconciled.
A source-to-outcome reconciliation confirms the relevant records and definitions reconcile.

nodes.finding: Realistic job previews were linked to voluntary turnover through perceived organizational honesty in a meta-analytic path analysis.
nodes.limitation: Supports an expectations mechanism. It does not identify a client-specific effect or a star-gap threshold.

nodes.finding: Psychological contract breach was related to work attitudes and turnover intentions; the meta-analysis did not find a reliable association with actual turnover.
nodes.limitation: Verify why employees left and test alternative contributors.

nodes.finding: Newcomer adjustment includes role clarity, which was related to downstream work outcomes.
nodes.limitation: Does not quantify the impact of a promotion framework on a given cohort.

nodes.finding: A field experiment gave retail managers explicit retention goals and measured quits.
nodes.limitation: A retail management intervention provides a directional precedent, with different context and intervention from coaching elsewhere.

nodes.finding: Job demands and resources measured across occupational groups relate to different burnout dimensions.
nodes.limitation: A reported workload problem is not a clinical diagnosis or proof of turnover causation.

nodes.finding: Controlled studies found a small pooled reduction in exhaustion after organizational interventions, with very low certainty.
nodes.limitation: Do not transfer the pooled effect to a client or infer impact on actual exits.

nodes.finding: Accessible forms use necessary inputs, clear labels and recoverable errors.
nodes.limitation: Design guidance, with no universal completion-time target or effect size.

nodes.finding: Observed apply completion varied with application length.
nodes.limitation: Vendor observations can help design a test. They do not identify a causal effect for a new applicant funnel.

nodes.finding: Favorable applicant reactions related to employer perceptions and reported acceptance and recommendation intentions.
nodes.limitation: Does not establish a universal callback SLA or a conversion uplift.

nodes.finding: Reputation, job and company information, and site vividness interacted in business students’ perceptions of recruiting firms.
nodes.limitation: Perceptions from this sample do not establish a site-specific applicant conversion effect.

nodes.finding: Shorter questionnaires and selected reminders can improve response in some settings.
nodes.limitation: Response and representativeness are distinct; local candidate effects are unknown.

nodes.finding: Voluntary employer reviews can overrepresent extreme opinions.
nodes.limitation: Ratings and review volume cannot establish a local operational cause by themselves.

nodes.finding: Recruitment word-of-mouth studies found that source and disclosed incentives influenced employer attractiveness.
nodes.limitation: Does not prove the success or harm of a given advocacy campaign.

nodes.finding: AMEC calls for outcome and impact measurement and rejects advertising value equivalency as a measure of communication value.
nodes.limitation: An unattributed media cost estimate is not realized ROI.

nodes.finding: A retail quasi-experiment linked unequal raises and quit behavior.
nodes.limitation: Relevant as an alternative to test using comparable roles, with no transferable pay or quit threshold.

nodes.finding: An experiment in retail tested a bundle of more responsible scheduling practices and reported store performance effects.
nodes.limitation: Does not establish a universal retention effect or fit for other shift-based roles.

nodes.finding: The challenge requires readiness gates, workforce fit and a three-phase plan.
nodes.limitation: Policy constraint, not a published causal estimate.

nodes.finding: US establishment data show heterogeneity in vacancies, hiring rates and recruiting intensity.
nodes.limitation: An aggregate time-to-fill or low qualified count does not establish labor scarcity. Verify exposure, role requirements and competing stages locally.

nodes.finding: The federal hiring roadmap separates needs validation, review, interviews and offers into stages.
nodes.limitation: Use only as a process measurement example. Its deadlines and governance requirements are specific to its setting.

nodes.finding: The meta-analysis examined associations of job, organizational and recruitment-process characteristics with applicant attraction, intentions and job choice.
nodes.limitation: Does not establish why a specific offer was declined or isolate the effect of changing a term.

nodes.finding: Social media field experiments tested employer messages using clicks as an early indicator of interest.
nodes.limitation: A click is neither a qualified application nor a hire. The setting was public employers.

nodes.finding: The authors studied pre-entry withdrawal after acceptance, including an archival telecommunications sample.
nodes.limitation: The reported rate belongs to that sample. The source does not prove a specific communication workflow prevents nonstarts.

nodes.finding: An analysis of internal hires at one health-services firm compared posting with manager-designated moves and found differing outcomes.
nodes.limitation: Observational evidence from one firm cannot establish a universal causal retention effect.

nodes.finding: A randomized trial at a Chinese technology company evaluated a specific hybrid schedule and found lower attrition in the treatment group.
nodes.limitation: Applies to the studied schedule and role setting. Verify feasibility and measure local outcomes.

nodes.finding: A study of manufacturing teams found team psychological safety associated with learning behavior.
nodes.limitation: Low reporting alone cannot diagnose fear or establish a turnover effect. Confidential verification and applicable case procedures are needed.

nodes.finding: A meta-analysis examined effectiveness and design moderators of leadership training.
nodes.limitation: Training outcomes do not establish a client's turnover effect. Evaluate management behavior and local retention separately.

nodes.label: Expectation drift may contribute to early exits
nodes.diagnostic: Compare dated promises, observed work practices and reasons for exits over a comparable hire window.
nodes.pilot: Pilot accurate role previews and correct the verified gap in work practices.
nodes.scale_gate: Scale when new hires report alignment and comparable early-exit indicators improve.

nodes.label: A management practice may contribute to exits
nodes.diagnostic: Compare exits and reported decision rights or manager practices across comparable teams and tenure.
nodes.pilot: Pilot manager coaching and an explicit agreement on delegation in affected teams.
nodes.scale_gate: Extend after delegation feedback and comparable early retention improve.

nodes.label: Unclear role or progression expectations may contribute to early exits
nodes.diagnostic: Review onboarding responsibilities, leveling criteria and exit reasons by role and cohort.
nodes.pilot: Pilot a structured onboarding and role-expectation review with a named owner.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand after role clarity improves and comparable exit indicators show no deterioration.

nodes.label: Excess workload may contribute to employee exhaustion
nodes.diagnostic: Compare staffing, overtime and confidential listening by cohort; check schedule instability and workload changes.
nodes.pilot: Co-design a capacity or workload change in the affected team.
nodes.scale_gate: Scale after sustained workload and exhaustion measures improve without shifting the burden to another cohort.

nodes.label: A mobile application obstacle may explain pre-submission loss
nodes.diagnostic: Compare starts and submissions by device and role, then reproduce the failure at the suspected form step.
nodes.pilot: Pilot an accessible form that keeps eligibility questions and removes a verified obstacle.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand after qualified submissions improve without worse eligibility, accessibility or recruiter response.

nodes.label: A post-submission handoff may explain hiring delays
nodes.diagnostic: Measure elapsed time from submission to first contact and subsequent funnel stages by cohort.
nodes.pilot: Pilot a named recruiter queue and response review for the affected roles.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand after response times and qualified progression improve without shifting the queue elsewhere.

nodes.label: Unclear role information may weaken candidate attraction
nodes.diagnostic: Interview target candidates and review conversion for the same jobs and inbound channels.
nodes.pilot: Test verified role details in job ads and compare qualified completions for similar traffic.
nodes.scale_gate: Scale after qualified applications improve while access and eligibility hold.

nodes.label: A local operating issue may explain uneven site reputation
nodes.diagnostic: Compare themes, sample counts and local operational records for the affected sites.
nodes.pilot: Pilot local ownership and fix the issue independently verified at those sites.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand the workflow after coverage and local operational outcomes improve.

nodes.label: Fragmented feedback collection may hide candidate experience issues
nodes.diagnostic: Reconcile eligible candidates, invitations, responses and timestamps by stage and site.
nodes.pilot: Pilot a short accessible survey and documented invitations at an affected site.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand once response coverage improves and nonresponse patterns are checked.

nodes.label: Manual workflows may limit reporting coverage and consume staff time
nodes.diagnostic: Audit duplicate handling, reporting effort, source coverage, and ownership.
nodes.pilot: Instrument verified tracking steps with source IDs and document staff time and conversion separately.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand after completeness, auditability and staff time improve.

nodes.label: An existing willing cohort may support a scoped advocacy pilot
nodes.diagnostic: Verify target audience fit, meaningful outcomes, voluntary participation and readiness in the relevant cohort.
nodes.pilot: Trial opt-in, role-relevant participation with auditable tracking.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand only with credible internal conditions, consent and measured audience or hiring outcomes.

nodes.label: A delayed hire process may contribute to agency dependence
nodes.diagnostic: Reconcile agency invoices and filled requisitions, then identify the funnel stage delaying the same roles.
nodes.pilot: Pilot targeted recruiter capacity for roles with verified avoidable external spend.
nodes.scale_gate: Scale after direct qualified hires improve and Finance verifies changes in agency spend.

nodes.label: A cohort-specific pay gap may contribute to exits
nodes.diagnostic: Audit comparable pay and exit reasons within the same role, location and tenure window.
nodes.pilot: If a meaningful discrepancy is verified, pilot a targeted compensation correction with Finance.
nodes.scale_gate: Review fairness and comparable retention before expanding any pay change.

nodes.label: Short-notice or unstable shifts may contribute to work strain
nodes.diagnostic: Compare roster notice, coverage and strain; check whether the target workforce actually works shifts.
nodes.pilot: Pilot more predictable shift assignments with the affected workers and operational owner.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand if roster stability improves without worse coverage or workload.

nodes.label: A limited qualified applicant pool may delay hiring
nodes.diagnostic: Count qualified applicants per approved requisition by role and market. Verify essential criteria, distribution and form completion before calling the pool small.
nodes.pilot: Test one additional sourcing route for the verified role and region. Track eligible applicants per requisition and keep essential qualifications fixed.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand if eligible applicants per opening and qualified hires improve without worsening cost or assessment quality.

nodes.label: A pre-posting approval queue may delay vacancy fulfillment
nodes.diagnostic: Compare request, sign-off, posting and acceptance timestamps. Verify whether the time-to-hire clock even includes time in approval.
nodes.pilot: Pilot a standard request checklist and named approver for one role family while retaining existing hiring and budget controls.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand if the request-to-post interval improves and approval exceptions or hiring-control failures do not increase.

nodes.label: Interview slot availability may delay qualified candidates
nodes.diagnostic: Measure screens, scheduling attempts and actual interview starts. Separate panel capacity from recruiter contact and candidate availability.
nodes.pilot: Reserve interview blocks with trained backup interviewers and let eligible candidates choose accessible slots.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand after verified interview wait times fall and assessment quality and candidate access hold.

nodes.label: Offer conditions may explain a late-stage loss of candidates
nodes.diagnostic: Reconcile extended, declined and expired offers. Confirm role-level decline reasons and separate terms, approval timing and competing offers.
nodes.pilot: Test clearer and earlier disclosure of approved offer conditions. Escalate term changes through the relevant decision owners.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand if offer acceptance and subsequent starts improve while compensation and fairness controls hold.

nodes.label: Off-target screening criteria may exclude eligible applicants
nodes.diagnostic: Manually review de-identified decisions against job-validated essentials and look for structured counterexamples before changing the screen.
nodes.pilot: Review questioned criteria with HR and role experts and pilot a documented, job-relevant rubric with human review.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand only after assessment quality and accessible progression improve while required qualifications are preserved.

nodes.label: A sourcing channel may be missing the intended workforce
nodes.diagnostic: Compare target cohort impressions, qualified visits and application outcomes by channel. Check whether the issue is reach, ad information or the apply flow.
nodes.pilot: Test one role-appropriate channel with comparable job information and attributable qualified outcomes.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand if incremental qualified reach and applications justify the cost and there is no reduction in access.

nodes.label: A pre-start communication gap may contribute to nonstarts
nodes.diagnostic: Check accepted offers, scheduled starts, withdrawals and confirmed contact while preserving candidate confidentiality.
nodes.pilot: Pilot an opt-in contact schedule with confirmed instructions, a named contact and a way to resolve access or scheduling problems.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand after measured starts improve without intrusive follow-up or worse candidate experience.

nodes.label: Restricted access to internal openings may contribute to exits
nodes.diagnostic: Compare internal posting visibility, applicant access and exit themes by role and tenure. Check actual opportunities apart from clarity about progression.
nodes.pilot: Pilot transparent access to relevant vacancies and a documented transfer review, preserving eligibility and role requirements.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand if equitable access and mobility improve while monitoring retention in the same group.

nodes.label: A feasible location change may address a reported retention barrier
nodes.diagnostic: Verify commute or location concerns in the affected cohort and confirm that service, access and team responsibilities allow a trial.
nodes.pilot: Test an opt-in, role-compatible schedule for one cohort with coverage and collaboration safeguards.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand only if the local trial meets coverage, collaboration and retention criteria.

nodes.label: Fear of speaking up may limit visibility into workplace problems
nodes.diagnostic: Compare confidential reporting access, independently corroborated concerns and follow-up coverage. Refer individual allegations to appropriate safeguarding processes.
nodes.pilot: Pilot confidential aggregate listening and tracked follow-up with a responsible HR owner. Keep individual case handling outside this workflow.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand only after safe access and response quality are demonstrated. Assess participation separately from incident prevalence.

nodes.label: Review collection changes may explain some apparent reputation movement
nodes.diagnostic: Compare review counts and respondent mix by platform, site and period. Cross-check changes against independent operational and listening records.
nodes.pilot: Publish a coverage-aware reputation view separating like-for-like trends from composition changes.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand when independent site evidence is linked and coverage differences are visible in management reports.

nodes.label: Missing attribution limits what can be inferred about hiring impact
nodes.diagnostic: Reconcile source identifiers and downstream events. Check whether reach, candidate response or qualified outcomes are genuinely unmeasured.
nodes.pilot: Pilot an auditable source-to-outcome ledger with deduplicated events and separate reporting for reach, qualified applications and hires.
nodes.scale_gate: Expand after completeness and reconciliation improve and comparisons use consistent outcome definitions.
